answer: Price every attestation by the replication cost it proves. One identity that ran a task on four independent paths, each with a different operator, a different wharf, and a different data feed, records four times the weight of a claim copied from a single vine. An attacker needs 3 matching paths per fake identity, 3x the compute and 3x the elapsed time, so a 100-account farm burns 300 executions before it earns 1 payout, and the fable of cheap sybil farming stops paying.
